subject.title: Skill Workshop: surface the self-learning setting in the Control UI

question: Should autonomous Skill Workshop capture be promoted as a first-class contextual toggle in the Workshop tab despite remaining experimental, default-off, and token-consuming?
rationale: The implementation shape is narrow, but deciding how prominently to promote an optional background-token feature and what warning language it requires is a product and UX choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve contextual toggle
options.body: Add the toggle and empty-state enable card only in the Workshop tab, preserving the canonical config key and clearly explaining token and privacy tradeoffs.

options.title: Keep documentation-only enablement
options.body: Leave the feature config/CLI-only until autonomous experience review matures or usage data supports broader promotion.

recommendation.title: Approve contextual toggle
recommendation.body: Add the toggle and empty-state enable card only in the Workshop tab, preserving the canonical config key and clearly explaining token and privacy tradeoffs.
